scope: From the seat of the employee, for the WA cradle-to-grave lives (c056, c072): ss 4(1) employee, 4A (equivalent separate entitlement, as an input), 5 (cashing out), 6 and 6A (continuous employment and counting its length), 7, 7A, 7B, 7C (ordinary pay), 7E-7H (transfer of business) with s 41, 8(1)-(3) (8 2/3 weeks after 10 years, 4 1/3 weeks per further 5 years, pro rata on termination after 7 years unless dismissed for serious misconduct), 9 (taking leave, double or half, payment in advance, public holidays, payment on termination), 10 (leave in advance), 26A (seeing records), 27 (working during leave). Out: the 2006 transitional rules in s 8(4)-(10), the former s 6 for pre-20 June 2022 transmissions (reported, not answered), s 7(3), s 7I, s 26 record-keeping, and ss 11, 12, 37-39 (machinery).

roles: I am an employee in Western Australia
I employ people in Western Australia
I am the personal representative of an employee who has died

situation_parameters.name: I have had an absence or break in my employment
situation_parameters.description: Whether your employment with this employer has had an absence, leave, a stand-down, a dismissal and re-employment, or a gap between engagements (s 6)
situation_parameters.role: I am an employee in Western Australia
questions: Is my employment still continuous after this absence or break
Does this absence count towards my length of service

situation_parameters.name: I have moved to a new employer
situation_parameters.description: Whether your employment with one employer ended and you then became employed by another (ss 7D-7H)
situation_parameters.role: I am an employee in Western Australia
questions: Does my service carry over to my new employer

situation_parameters.name: my employment has ended
situation_parameters.description: Whether your employment with this employer has ended, by resignation, dismissal, redundancy or otherwise
situation_parameters.role: I am an employee in Western Australia
questions: How many weeks of long service leave am I entitled to now my employment has ended
How many weeks of long service leave must I be paid out
How much must I be paid for long service leave now my employment has ended
How many weeks of leave taken in advance can my employer recover from my final pay

situation_parameters.name: I am taking, or about to take, long service leave
situation_parameters.description: Whether you are on long service leave, or have arranged or asked to take it, or are taken to have started it when your employment ended (s 9(2))
situation_parameters.role: I am an employee in Western Australia
questions: How many weeks of leave do I get if my request is granted
What fraction of my ordinary pay am I paid during my leave
Must I be paid for my leave before it starts
How many days longer is my leave because of public holidays
Do I forfeit the rest of my leave by working elsewhere during it

situation_parameters.name: my employee's employment has ended
situation_parameters.description: Whether the employment of the employee you are asking about has ended
situation_parameters.role: I employ people in Western Australia
questions: How many weeks of long service leave must I pay out to my employee
How much must I pay my employee for long service leave now their employment has ended
How many weeks of leave taken in advance may I deduct from my employee's final pay
